material_change: The successor separates rights-cleared public development from two genuinely new externally held waves, names eight domain rubrics and six primary comparator slots, adds no-revision harm sentinels, requires source- and provider-disjoint replication, and fail-closes on rights, comparator, evaluator, custody, freshness, ontology, or block-independence defects.

allowed: verify predecessor bytes and additive amendments
retain the 21/24 descriptive archive and all three errors
retain CANNOT_CHECK and REFUSED_UNBOUND execution receipts
prohibited: reseal or reuse the published 24-case suite
rewrite a null, harmful, adverse, or CANNOT_CHECK predecessor as positive

allowed: adapter conformance and deterministic interface tests
the three registered residual 2x2 discriminator studies
open-set ontology annotation and reliability pilots
outcome-blind source, rights, and 64-cell feasibility accounting
prohibited: freshness, custody, independence, harm-benefit, or superiority claims

required_before_candidate_generation: root-by-content-class rights disposition for every selected byte
complete 64-cell eligibility table with no silent reassignment
six exact primary comparator manifests and adapters
subject, candidate, model, provider, tool, budget, seed, epoch, and environment identities
protected evaluator, fresh-transfer evaluator, harm adjudicator, and verifier identities

disjoint_from_primary: provider or host organization where feasible and otherwise a preregistered worst-group limitation

design.same_visible_symptom_block_definition: Within each domain and wave, one frozen symptom signature identifies eight globally source-disjoint project/issue-family clusters, one for each revision class. Candidate-visible equivalence is adjudicated before protected labels or outcomes are opened. Block identity is retained in all analyses.
design.source_disjointness_rule: No repository, project lineage, issue family, patch lineage, attachment root, case author, or protected evaluator-authored derivative may contribute more than one independent cluster anywhere in the same wave.
design.analysis_rule: All paired arm contrasts use the project/issue-family cluster as the unit and preserve symptom-block membership. Case views, reruns, metrics, and arms never increase n. Any dependence or source collision that invalidates this unit triggers a power redesign under a new successor identity before outcome access.
noncompensatory_gates: minimality and no excess broad revision
every one of six frozen primary comparator contrasts

domains.eligibility_rubric: Versioned systems whose outputs inform biomedical experiments, clinical research, or clinical evidence workflows; generic health-app UI defects without a scientific or evidence consequence are excluded.
Versioned systems for molecular, cellular, organismal, ecological, or omics experiments; purely administrative laboratory software is excluded.
Versioned systems for climate, geospatial, atmospheric, ocean, hydrologic, or environmental inference and measurement.
Versioned systems for physics, chemistry, astronomy, or materials inference, simulation, measurement, or theory testing.
Versioned systems for engineering design, controls, robotics, instrumentation, digital twins, or safety-relevant simulation.
Versioned research software, numerical methods, scientific workflows, and data-intensive research infrastructure whose failure changes a scientific result or its evidential status.
Versioned systems for social, behavioral, educational, policy, or economic measurement and inference; generic business automation is excluded.
Versioned systems for theorem, proof, formal verification, statistical method, identifiability, or mathematical model development with an auditable correctness target.

revision_classes.minimal_front: Change acquisition, routing, provenance, coverage, or evidence authority without changing the registered measurement, representation, model class, evaluator, or execution substrate.
Change an instrument, label, proxy, calibration, sampling, or measurement mapping while holding the downstream model family and evaluator fixed.
Change parameters, objectives, priors, inference, or training within the already licensed model class and representation.
Expand or replace the hypothesis/model family because no licensed within-class change can resolve the protected responsibility.
Change state variables, ontology, encoding, interface, memory, or typed artifact regime while holding the scientific target fixed.
Change environment, dependency, toolchain, runtime, hardware, orchestration, or implementation bytes without changing the scientific method class.
Change tests, scorers, acceptance rules, harm adjudication, or evaluator implementation because the prior evaluator is defective or target-misaligned.

Return no unique authorized revision when allowed diagnostics do not separate competing fronts, the ontology is incomplete, rights prevent adjudication, or more than one incomparable minimal front remains.

claim_logic.primary_only: A positive primary wave can support only the exact frozen primary panel and every stated noncompensatory gate; it cannot support cross-provider or cross-time transport.
claim_logic.broad_transport: A wider claim requires both source/provider/time-disjoint waves, every six-arm contrast, every worst-group floor, all sentinel and harm gates, and a verifier-signed archive.
claim_logic.failure_recursion: Every material change to intervention, comparator, population, rights basis, custody, or endpoint receives a new successor identity. Negative, null, harmful, interaction, and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes remain immutable.

explicit_nonclaims: No beneficial or transferable self-improvement result exists in this lane.
Public gold is not protected freshness.
A remote API is not independent or immutable evaluator custody without a versioned backend, task registry, access log, rights disposition, and verifier receipt.
A paper-derived mechanism reimplementation is not an official solver reproduction.
Local role names do not establish owner separation.
The 21/24 descriptive archive is not a protected confirmatory result and may not be resealed.
